  intro a a₁ a₂ h₁ h₂
  induction h₁ generalizing a₂
  · exact ⟨_, h₂, .refl _⟩
  · cases h₂
    · exact ⟨_, .refl _, .red_I _⟩
    · exact ⟨_, .refl _, .refl _⟩
    · rename_i _ _ _ hp hq
      exact ⟨_, hq, I_irreducible _ hp ▸ .red_I _⟩
  · cases h₂
    · exact ⟨_, .refl _, .red_K ..⟩
    · exact ⟨_, .refl _, .refl _⟩
    · rename_i _ _ _ _ hp _
      obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := Ka_irreducible _ _ hp
      exact ⟨_, hx, .red_K ..⟩
  · cases h₂
    · exact ⟨_, .refl _, .red_S ..⟩
    · exact ⟨_, .refl _, .refl _⟩

      obtain ⟨x, y, hx, hy, rfl⟩ := Sab_irreducible _ _ _ hp
      exact ⟨_, .par (.par hx hq) $ .par hy hq, .red_S ..⟩
  · rename_i a a' b b' ha hb ih₁ ih₂
    cases h₂
    · exact ⟨_, .refl _, .par ha hb⟩
    · exact ⟨_, I_irreducible _ ha ▸ .red_I _, hb⟩
    · obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := Ka_irreducible _ _ ha

    · obtain ⟨x, y, hx, hy, rfl⟩ := Sab_irreducible _ _ _ ha

theorem putnam_1995_a3
(relation : (Fin 9 → ℤ) → (Fin 9 → ℤ) → Prop)
(digits_to_num : (Fin 9 → ℤ) → ℤ)
(hdigits_to_num : digits_to_num = fun dig => ∑ i : Fin 9, (dig i) * 10^i.1)
(hrelation : ∀ d e : (Fin 9 → ℤ), relation d e ↔ (∀ i : Fin 9, d i < 10 ∧ d i ≥ 0 ∧ e i < 10 ∧ e i ≥ 0) ∧ (∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ (digits_to_num (fun j : Fin 9 => if j = i then e j else d j))))
: ∀ d e f : (Fin 9 → ℤ), ((relation d e) ∧ (relation e f)) → (∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ d i - f i) := by
  intro d e f h
  have A := ((hrelation d e).mp h.1).2
  have B := ((hrelation e f).mp h.2).2
  have upd (x y : Fin 9 → ℤ) (i : Fin 9) :
      digits_to_num (fun j => if j = i then y j else x j)
        = (y i - x i) * 10 ^ (i : ℕ) + digits_to_num x := by
    refine eq_add_of_sub_eq ?_
    simp only [hdigits_to_num, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ite_mul, ite_sub, ← sub_mul, sub_self,
      Finset.sum_ite_eq', Finset.mem_univ, if_true]
  have h7 : 7 ∣ digits_to_num e + digits_to_num d := by
    have h_eq : digits_to_num e + digits_to_num d
        = (∑ i : Fin 9, ((e i - d i) * 10 ^ (i : ℕ) + digits_to_num d)) - 7 * digits_to_num d := by
      simp only [Finset.sum_add_distrib, sub_mul, hdigits_to_num, Finset.sum_sub_distrib,
        Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, Int.nsmul_eq_mul, Nat.cast_ofNat]
      ring
    rw [h_eq]
    exact dvd_sub (Finset.dvd_sum fun i _ ↦ (upd d e i) ▸ A i) ⟨digits_to_num d, rfl⟩
  intro i
  exact ((by decide : IsCoprime (7 : ℤ) 10).pow_right : IsCoprime (7 : ℤ) (10 ^ (i : ℕ))).dvd_of_dvd_mul_right
    (by convert (dvd_sub h7 (dvd_add ((upd d e i) ▸ A i) ((upd e f i) ▸ B i))) using 1; ring)

lemma ι_timeOrderF_superCommuteF_eq_time {φ ψ : 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp}
    (hφψ : crAnTimeOrderRel φ ψ) (hψφ : crAnTimeOrderRel ψ φ) (a b : 𝓕.FieldOpFreeAlgebra) :
    ι 𝓣ᶠ(a * [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * b) =
    ι ([ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * 𝓣ᶠ(a * b)) := by
  refine Submodule.span_induction₂ (p := fun x y _ _ =>
      ι 𝓣ᶠ(x * [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * y) =
      ι ([ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * 𝓣ᶠ(x * y))) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
    (Basis.mem_span ofCrAnListFBasis a) (Basis.mem_span ofCrAnListFBasis b)
  · rintro x y ⟨φs', rfl⟩ ⟨φs, rfl⟩
    simp only [ofListBasis_eq_ofList]
    let l₁ := List.takeWhile (fun c => ¬ crAnTimeOrderRel φ c)
      (List.insertionSort 𝓕.crAnTimeOrderRel (φs' ++ φs))
    let l₂ := List.filter (fun c => crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel c φ) φs'
    let l₃ := List.filter (fun c => crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel c φ) φs
    let l₄ := List.filter (fun c => crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ ¬ crAnTimeOrderRel c φ)
      (List.insertionSort 𝓕.crAnTimeOrderRel (φs' ++ φs))
    let A := ι (ofCrAnListF (l₁ ++ l₂))
    let B := ι (ofCrAnListF (l₃ ++ l₄))
    have hsp (m : List 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp) :
        ι (ofCrAnListF (l₁ ++ l₂ ++ m ++ l₃ ++ l₄)) = A * ι (ofCrAnListF m) * B := by
      simp only [A, B, ← ofCrAnListF_append, ← map_mul, List.append_assoc]
    have hs : crAnTimeOrderSign (φs' ++ [ψ, φ] ++ φs) =
        crAnTimeOrderSign (φs' ++ [φ, ψ] ++ φs) := by
      simp [crAnTimeOrderSign_swap_eq_time hψφ hφψ]
    have h₁ : crAnTimeOrderList (φs' ++ [φ, ψ] ++ φs) = l₁ ++ l₂ ++ [φ, ψ] ++ l₃ ++ l₄ :=
      insertionSort_of_eq_list 𝓕.crAnTimeOrderRel φ φs' [φ, ψ] φs (by simp [hφψ, hψφ])
    have h₂ : crAnTimeOrderList (φs' ++ [ψ, φ] ++ φs) = l₁ ++ l₂ ++ [ψ, φ] ++ l₃ ++ l₄ :=
      insertionSort_of_eq_list 𝓕.crAnTimeOrderRel φ φs' [ψ, φ] φs (by simp [hφψ, hψφ])
    have h₃ : crAnTimeOrderList (φs' ++ φs) = l₁ ++ l₂ ++ l₃ ++ l₄ :=
      insertionSort_of_takeWhile_filter 𝓕.crAnTimeOrderRel φ φs' φs
    have hcm : ι [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF =
        ι (ofCrAnListF [φ, ψ]) - 𝓢(𝓕 |>ₛ φ, 𝓕 |>ₛ ψ) • ι (ofCrAnListF [ψ, φ]) := by
      rw [← ofCrAnListF_singleton, ← ofCrAnListF_singleton, superCommuteF_ofCrAnListF_ofCrAnListF]
      simp only [map_sub, map_smul, List.cons_append, List.nil_append, ofList_singleton]
    have hL : ι 𝓣ᶠ(ofCrAnListF φs' * [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * ofCrAnListF φs) =
        crAnTimeOrderSign (φs' ++ [φ, ψ] ++ φs) • (A * ι [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * B) := by
      conv_lhs => rw [← ofCrAnListF_singleton, ← ofCrAnListF_singleton,
        superCommuteF_ofCrAnListF_ofCrAnListF]
      simp only [List.singleton_append, ofList_singleton, mul_sub, sub_mul, ← ofCrAnListF_append,
        Algebra.mul_smul_comm, Algebra.smul_mul_assoc, timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF, map_sub, map_smul]
      rw [hs, h₁, h₂, hsp [φ, ψ], hsp [ψ, φ], hcm]
      simp only [mul_sub, sub_mul, Algebra.smul_mul_assoc, Algebra.mul_smul_comm, smul_smul]
      module
    have hR : ι ([ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * 𝓣ᶠ(ofCrAnListF φs' * ofCrAnListF φs)) =
        crAnTimeOrderSign (φs' ++ φs) • (A * ι [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * B) := by
      rw [← ofCrAnListF_append, timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF, Algebra.mul_smul_comm, map_smul, h₃,
        map_mul]
      have hAB : ι (ofCrAnListF (l₁ ++ l₂ ++ l₃ ++ l₄)) = A * B := by
        simp only [A, B, ← ofCrAnListF_append, ← map_mul, List.append_assoc]
      rw [hAB, ← mul_assoc, ← (Subalgebra.mem_center_iff.mp (ι_superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF_mem_center φ ψ)), mul_assoc]
    rw [hL, hR]
    by_cases hq : (𝓕 |>ₛ φ) = (𝓕 |>ₛ ψ)
    · simp only [List.append_assoc, List.cons_append, List.nil_append, crAnTimeOrderSign,
        Wick.koszulSign_eq_rel_eq_stat 𝓕.crAnStatistics 𝓕.crAnTimeOrderRel hφψ hψφ hq.symm]
    · simp only [ι_superCommuteF_of_diff_statistic hq, mul_zero, zero_mul, smul_zero]
  all_goals (intros; simp only [add_mul, mul_add, zero_mul, mul_zero, map_add, map_zero,
    map_smul, Algebra.smul_mul_assoc, Algebra.mul_smul_comm, *])

lemma fundamental_theorem_of_variational_calculus' {f : Y → V}
    (μ : Measure Y) [IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ] [μ.IsOpenPosMeasure]
    [OpensMeasurableSpace Y]
    (hf : Continuous f) (hg : ∀ g, IsTestFunction g → ∫ x, ⟪f x, g x⟫_ℝ ∂μ = 0) :
    f = 0 := by
  funext x₀
  by_contra hx0
  have hpos := lt_of_le_of_ne' real_inner_self_nonneg' (inner_self_eq_zero'.not.mpr hx0)
  have hc := Continuous.inner' (𝕜 := ℝ) f (fun _ => f x₀) hf continuous_const
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hp⟩ := Metric.eventually_nhds_iff_ball.mp
    (hc.continuousAt.eventually (eventually_gt_nhds hpos))
  let φ : ContDiffBump x₀ := ⟨δ/2, δ, half_pos hδ, half_lt_self hδ⟩
  have hcm := φ.continuous.mul hc
  exact (mul_pos (φ.pos_of_mem_ball (Metric.mem_ball_self hδ)) hpos).ne'
    (congrFun (Measure.eq_of_ae_eq
    ((integral_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg (fun x => by
        by_cases hx : x ∈ Metric.ball x₀ δ
        · exact mul_nonneg φ.nonneg (hp x hx).le
        · simp [φ.zero_of_le_dist (not_lt.mp hx)])
      (hcm.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport φ.hasCompactSupport.mul_right)).mp (by simpa [inner_smul_right'] using hg (fun x => φ x • f x₀) (IsTestFunction.smul_right ⟨φ.contDiff, φ.hasCompactSupport⟩ contDiff_const)))
      hcm continuous_const) x₀)

theorem fiberwise_dist_lt_imp_dist_lt_unique_decoding_radius (i : Fin ℓ) (steps : ℕ)
    [NeZero steps] (h_i_add_steps : i.val + steps ≤ ℓ)
    (f : OracleFunction 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩)
  (h_fw_dist_lt : fiberwiseClose 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    (i := i) (steps := steps) (h_i_add_steps := h_i_add_steps) (f := f)) :
  hammingClose 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩ f := by
  unfold hammingClose
  let I : Fin (ℓ + 1) := ⟨i, by omega⟩
  let C_i := BBF_Code 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) I
  let d_fw := fiberwiseDistance 𝔽q β (i := i) steps h_i_add_steps f
  let d_i := BBF_CodeDistance ℓ 𝓡 I
  let d_i' := BBF_CodeDistance ℓ 𝓡 ⟨i.val + steps, by omega⟩
  have h_alg : (d_i' - 1) * 2 ^ steps + 1 = d_i := by
    dsimp only [BBF_CodeDistance, Nat.add_one_sub_one, d_i, d_i']
    rw [Nat.sub_mul, ← Nat.pow_add, ← Nat.pow_add,
      ← Nat.sub_add_comm (Nat.le_trans h_i_add_steps (Nat.le_add_right ℓ 𝓡)), Nat.add_sub_add_right,
      ← Nat.sub_add_comm h_i_add_steps, Nat.add_sub_add_right]
  obtain ⟨g', hg', h_min⟩ : ∃ g' ∈ C_i,
      d_fw = (fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f g').ncard := by
    have h : d_fw ∈ (fun g : C_i =>
        (fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f g).ncard) '' Set.univ :=
      Nat.sInf_mem (Set.image_nonempty.mpr Set.univ_nonempty)
    rcases h with ⟨g, _, h_eq⟩
    exact ⟨g, g.prop, h_eq.symm⟩
  have hb : hammingDist f g' ≤ d_fw * 2 ^ steps := by
    let Y := fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f g'
    haveI : Fintype ↥Y := Fintype.ofFinite ↥Y
    have hYc : Y.ncard = Fintype.card ↥Y := by
      rw [←_root_.Nat.card_coe_set_eq, card_eq_fintype_card]
    rw [h_min, hYc]
    let Δ := Finset.filter (fun x => f x ≠ g' x) Finset.univ
    have hΔ : hammingDist f g' = Δ.card := by simp only [hammingDist, ne_eq, Δ]
    rw [hΔ]
    have hsub : Δ ⊆ ((Finset.univ : Finset ↥Y) ×ˢ Finset.univ).image
        (fun p : ↥Y × Fin (2 ^ steps) => qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩)
          (steps := steps) (h_i_add_steps := fin_ℓ_steps_lt_ℓ_add_R i steps h_i_add_steps)
          (y := p.1) p.2) := by
      intro x hx
      let y := iteratedQuotientMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i steps h_i_add_steps x
      have hy : y ∈ Y := ⟨x, rfl, (Finset.mem_filter.mp hx).2⟩
      apply Finset.mem_image.mpr
      refine ⟨⟨⟨y, hy⟩, pointToIterateQuotientIndex (i := I) (steps := steps)
          (h_i_add_steps := h_i_add_steps) (x := x)⟩,
        Finset.mem_product.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, Finset.mem_univ _⟩, ?_⟩
      exact (is_fiber_iff_generates_quotient_point 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps (x := x) (y := y)).mp rfl
    refine Nat.le_trans (Finset.card_le_card hsub) (Nat.le_trans Finset.card_image_le ?_)
    simp only [Finset.card_product, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, le_refl]
  have hbridge : Code.distFromCode f C_i ≤ (d_fw * 2 ^ steps : ℕ∞) :=
    (Code.distFromCode_le_dist_to_mem (C := (C_i : Set _)) f g' hg').trans (ENat.coe_le_coe.mpr hb)
  have h_nat : d_fw * 2 ^ steps + d_fw * 2 ^ steps < d_i := by
    rw [← two_mul, ← mul_assoc, ← h_alg]
    refine Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.mul_le_mul_right _
      (Nat.le_of_lt_succ (WithTop.coe_lt_coe.1 h_fw_dist_lt))) (Nat.lt_succ_self _)
  have h_fin : (2 : ℕ∞) * Code.distFromCode f C_i ≤ ↑(d_fw * 2 ^ steps + d_fw * 2 ^ steps) := by
    rw [two_mul, ENat.coe_add]
    exact add_le_add hbridge hbridge
  exact h_fin.trans_lt (ENat.coe_lt_coe.mpr h_nat)

theorem putnam_1964_a4
(u : ℕ → ℤ)
(boundedu : ∃ B T : ℤ, ∀ n : ℕ, B ≤ u n ∧ u n ≤ T)
(hu : ∀ n ≥ 4, u n = ((u (n - 1) + u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) * u (n - 4)) : ℝ) / (u (n - 1) * u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) + u (n - 4)) ∧ (u (n - 1) * u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) + u (n - 4)) ≠ 0)
: (∃ N c : ℕ, c > 0 ∧ ∀ n ≥ N, u (n + c) = u n) := by
  obtain ⟨B, T, hB⟩ := boundedu
  have hs : Set.Finite (Set.range fun n (m : Fin 4) => u (n+m)) :=
    (Set.Finite.pi fun _ => (Set.finite_Icc B T).subset (Set.range_subset_iff.mpr hB)).subset
      (Set.range_subset_iff.mpr fun _ _ _ => Set.mem_range_self _)
  obtain ⟨i, j, hij, h⟩ := hs.exists_lt_map_eq_of_forall_mem fun _ : ℕ => Set.mem_range_self _
  have hp : ∀ k, u (i+k+4-4) = u (j+k+4-4) ∧ u (i+k+4-3) = u (j+k+4-3) ∧ u (i+k+4-2) = u (j+k+4-2) ∧ u (i+k+4-1) = u (j+k+4-1) := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero => exact ⟨congrFun h 0, congrFun h 1, congrFun h 2, congrFun h 3⟩
    | succ k ih =>
      refine' ⟨ih.2.1, ih.2.2.1, ih.2.2.2, _⟩
      show u (i+k+4) = u (j+k+4)
      rw [← Int.cast_inj (α := ℝ), (hu (i+k+4) (Nat.le_add_left _ _)).1, (hu (j+k+4) (Nat.le_add_left _ _)).1, ih.1, ih.2.1, ih.2.2.1, ih.2.2.2]
  exact ⟨i, j-i, by omega, fun n hn => by
    rw [← Nat.add_sub_of_le hn, Nat.add_right_comm, Nat.add_sub_of_le (le_of_lt hij)]
    exact (hp (n-i)).1.symm⟩

theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly
  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val
 := by
  intro P_i f_i f_i_plus_1 new_coeffs P_i_plus_1 y
  let fiberMap := qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := 1)
    (h_i_add_steps := h_i_succ_lt) (y := y)
  let P₀ := evenRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  let P₁ := oddRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  have hq (k : Fin 2) : (qMap 𝔽q β ⟨i, by omega⟩).eval (fiberMap k : L) = y := by
    rw [generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i 1 (by omega) (fiberMap k) y ⟨k, rfl⟩,
      iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i (by omega)]
  have h₁ : (fiberMap 1 : L) = 1 + (fiberMap 0 : L) := by
    simp only [fiberMap, qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i (by omega) y 1,
      qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i (by omega) y 0, Fin2ToF2,
      if_neg (by decide : (1 : Fin 2) ≠ 0), ↓reduceIte, Submodule.coe_add, Submodule.coe_zero,
      one_smul, zero_smul, add_zero, zero_add,
      get_sDomain_first_basis_eq_1 𝔽q β (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (by omega)]
  have h_split := evaluation_poly_split_identity 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  have he : ∀ k : Fin 2,
      f_i (fiberMap k) = P₀.eval (y : L) + (fiberMap k : L) * P₁.eval (y : L) := by
    intro k
    simp only [f_i, P_i, P₀, P₁, h_split, Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_mul,
      Polynomial.eval_comp, Polynomial.eval_X, hq]
  have hpoly : Polynomial.C (1 - r_chal) * P₀ + Polynomial.C r_chal * P₁ = P_i_plus_1 := by
    simp only [P_i_plus_1, new_coeffs, P₀, P₁, evenRefinement, oddRefinement,
      intermediateEvaluationPoly, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib, mul_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro j _
    simp only [add_mul, Polynomial.C_add, Polynomial.C_mul]
    ring
  simp only [f_i_plus_1, fold]
  rw [he 0, he 1, h₁, ← hpoly]
  simp only [Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_C]
  ring
